newsitem.title: USA: United Technologies says may be subject to probes.
newsitem.headline: United Technologies says may be subject to probes.

text.p: United Technologies Corp said Monday it believes that, in light of the current government contracting environment, it will be the subject of one or more government investigations, according to a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission.
The company made the disclosure in a quarterly financial report to the SEC.

It noted that, if it or one of its business units were charged with wrongdoing as a result of any of these investigations, they could be suspended from bidding or receiving awards of new government contracts, pending completion of legal proceedings.

Any contracts found to be tainted by fraud could be voided by the government. It noted that, if found liable, it could be fined or debarred from government contracting for a period generally not to exceed three years.
Like many defense contractors, it has received audit reports that recommend certain contract prices be reduced to comply with government regulations.
Some of these audit reports involve substantial amounts, it noted. It said it has made voluntary refunds in those it believes appropriate.
